verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents Environments [launchdarkly-docs-9], which implies flag configuration can be separated into non-production environments, and it has a doc on testing changes to flag targeting [launchdarkly-docs-3]. The evidence is only titles, though: nothing shows that environments isolate data from production or that agent tooling such as the MCP server or CLI can be scoped to a sandbox environment. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sandbox/test environment isolation from production data, documentation of agent/MCP/CLI scoping to non-production environments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
